description: Replace UIContext.t() fn-field struct with a UI behaviour + GenServer. ctx.ui becomes a pid. 6 extensions use UI calls -- they migrate to UI.behaviour_function(ctx.ui, ...) syntax. Requires Phase 5 complete (extensions already use new state pattern).

comments.text: Audit (2026-04-26): UI behaviour landed but UIBridge was per-invocation and orphan-leaked (each session_start, command, and agent event spun up a new linked GenServer with no shutdown). Caused TUI exits when extensions were present. Replaced by direct Interactive UI implementation in opi-fin.15.

title: Phase 7: UI behaviour replaces UIContext fn-fields
